- It moderated to an average of 4.6 per cent during 2024-25 from 5.4 per cent during 2023-24 [Source: RBI, Page 17].

- Overall, headline inflation averaged 4.6 per cent during 2024-25, 73 basis points (bps) lower than the previous year [Source: RBI, Appendix Table 4].
